output.reason: Asymptomatic patient requesting STI screening after a new partner needs a clinician to select and order appropriate tests and timing, which can be arranged asynchronously without urgent or in-person assessment today.
output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review your request in this thread and arrange appropriate STI screening, including which tests fit your recent new-partner exposure and the right timing for each. No same-day visit is needed based on what you describe. If you develop genital sores, unusual discharge, painful urination, pelvic or belly pain, or fever, seek clinical care promptly rather than waiting.
